verdict.rationale: Helicone's first-party prompt-management docs describe saving prompts with commit histories and tags, comparing and rolling back versions, deploying versions independently per environment, and referencing a prompt by ID through the AI Gateway so changes take effect without code changes or redeploys. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the prompt versioning and deployment workflow (the community comment about templates is an older feature request and does not contradict the current docs).

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code

citations.quote: Test and deploy prompt changes instantly without rebuilding or redeploying your application
Use your prompt instantly by referencing its ID in your AI Gateway. No code changes, no rebuilds.
Track every change, compare versions, and rollback instantly if something goes wrong
Deploy different versions to production, staging, and development environments independently
Save any prompt with clear commit histories and tags.
